# Tests left out of the default pass of the GPU suite, one `PATTERN | REASON` per line (gtest
# patterns, several joined with `:`). A test belongs here when it has no meaning in this pass, or
# when the hardware it needs is not on the runner; the reason says which. It is counted as not
# applicable in the test report, with this reason, and it is not run in this pass.
#
# A pattern that matches no test is an error (see .github/scripts/run_gtest.py).

ConcurrencyTests/ConcurrentOpsTest.*:ConcurrentOpsFence.*:ConcurrentOpsPoolDrainTest.*:CKKSTest.ConcurrentHostShadowCopyOnWrite | Needs the concurrent-operations mode (FIDESLIB_CONCURRENT_OPS=1), which the default pass runs without; these tests run in the concurrent passes
ChebyshevFixedManual.HazeMatchesOpenFheOracle:Repro/ChebyshevFixedManualCoworker.*:DropInputHost.DecryptSurvivesDroppedInput:HazeBootstrap.* | Regression tests of the haze backend
CKKSTest.MakeCKKSPackedPlaintextDeviceFallsBackOnHostBackends:CKKSTest.MakeCKKSPackedPlaintextDeviceManyMatchesSingleOnHostBackends | Test the fallback of a backend that cannot encode on the device; the CUDA backend encodes on the device
P2PTransferTest.MultiGPUIfAvailable* | Need two or more GPUs; the runner has one
